metadata.description: Marketplace for the OPM engineering workflow plugin for Claude Code and its optional explainer-video add-on

plugins.name: opm
plugins.description: An opinionated engineering workflow: brainstorm, plan, TDD execution with fresh-context subagents, verification, captured learnings. Lean reviewers, stack patterns and six light safety hooks.

plugins.name: opm-video
plugins.description: Optional add-on: turns a spec or document into a narrated explainer video. Needs a headless browser, ffmpeg and a text-to-speech voice; the neural voice (edge-tts) sends narration text to a Microsoft cloud service unless the local OS voice is used.
